tagline: KMZ胶片单反相机，1952 年发布
description: KMZ于1952年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度Cloth focal-plane shutter. 1/25 - 1/500 sec plus B. Cable release socket in shutter release button. No delayed action. No flash synchronisation.。使用24x36 mm on standard 135 cartridge film。

specs.快门: Cloth focal-plane shutter. 1/25 - 1/500 sec plus B. Cable release socket in shutter release button. No delayed action. No flash synchronisation.
specs.取景器: Pentaprism viewfinder with ground glass focusing screen. No prismatic focusing aids. Mirror reset as film is advanced.
specs.尺寸: 140 x 50 x 90 mm (body only); depth with Industar-22 approx. 77 mm
specs.重量: 540 g body only); 610 g with Industar-22.
specs.英文简介: The Zenit (or Zenit 1) is a 35 mm SLR camera made by Krasnogorski Mekhanicheskii Zavod (KMZ) in Krasnagorsk near Moscow in the USSR, during the cold political climate of the early 1950’s.
